text:
Marta: Morning — quick callout: propose 'soft-deprecate sculpt' as a controlled lifecycle path. Summary: unify 30/90 -> 60d default, add a sculpt job that moves low-use tenants to a non-pinned variant with a 7d shadow/readiness window. Thoughts? :eyes:

Diego: From runtime: doable. Need clear thresholds. Suggest tokens/month < 150k AND no regen failures in last 30d. Also add KV priming task after sculpt to avoid regen spikes.

Ava: Product acceptance criteria suggestion:
- bench delta <= 2% on prioritized prompt slices in canary
- rollback < 10m (automated switch)
- comms + opt-out UI live before GA
- legal exceptions enumerated
I'll own comms + gate checklist.

Ken: Ops: require per-tenant trace IDs, sampling of pre/post outputs, and an alert if 99p latency increases >12% or error-rate >3%. Also we must support manual freeze for enterprise tenants.

LegalBot: Flag: many enterprise contracts call out "pinned version" language. Need opt-out + signed exceptions. Provide legal-approved wording before enabling for any paying customers.

Diego: Proposed canary plan:
1) Feature-flagged sculpt controller (flag off)
2) Shadow mode 14d for 4 internal tenants + 2 light customers
3) Live canary 7d with tracing + sample diffs
4) If metrics pass, enable soft-ttl 60d for cohort B with opt-out
Sample config snippet:
```json
{"sculpt":{"enabled":true,"usage_month_tokens":150000,"shadow_days":14,"live_days":7,"min_retention_days":14}}
```

Marta: Action items: Diego implement flag + priming job (owner Diego, due Thu EOD), Ken add alerts + manual freeze API (owner Ken, due Fri), Ava draft comm templates & acceptance report (owner Ava, due Mon), LegalBot to compile exception list (owner LegalBot, due Mon). ops-bot: schedule deploy dry-run to staging next Tue.

ops-bot: Pipeline queued: feature/sculpt -> staging 2026-04-06T03:00Z (dry-run).

Marta: Thanks. If anyone objects to the thresholds speak now or ping me. :thumbsup:
